 UEFA Champions League
 10-men Inter Milan edged Shakhtar Donetsk in UEFA Champions League
 Inter Milan overcame Alessandro Bastoni's dismissal to beat Shakhtar Donetsk, Carlos Augusto controlling Henrikh Mkhitaryan's long pass in his stride before scoring the 77th-minute winner.
 Bastoni had received a second booking eight minutes earlier for pushing an opponent away from the ball.
